programme.title: The Wood
programme.desc: Three black friends gather for a wedding, and recall their teen years growing up in 1980s Inglewood, Cal., after the groom gets cold feet and starts thinking about his high-school sweetheart. A touching and nostalgic coming-of-age tale.

programme.title: Witness
programme.desc: A cop investigates a murder witnessed by the son of an Amish widow in Peter Weir's study of culture clash.

programme.title: All the World is Sleeping
programme.desc: As an engaged couple plans their dream wedding, the groom is excited but doesn't inform his friends he's getting married. Confused by his secrecy, they hatch a plan to find out what he's hiding. Meanwhile, the bride seems withdrawn, and her groom starts worrying if this relationship is meant to be.

programme.title: Chantilly Bridge
programme.desc: The sequel film centers on the reunion of a group of friends and how they've navigated their hopes and dreams over the past 25 years. Reflecting on their experiences of parenthood, career, and menopause, the women share insightful observations and reconnect in a unique, life-affirming manner.

programme.title: The Other Woman
programme.desc: Jack leaves his wife for Emilia, only to find his new marriage marked by tragedy. His son William seems intent on making Emilia's life miserable, and their union takes a sharp turn for the worse when their newborn baby dies suddenly.

programme.title: A Crime On The Bayou
programme.desc: It is 1966 and Black teenager Gary Duncan finds himself in the middle of a heated argument between Black and white teens in front of a newly integrated school. In the process of diffusing the tension, he gently lays his hand on a white boy, who then reacts disproportionately. That night, authorities arrest him for assault. A Crime In The Bayou is a documentary that follows the story of Duncan and his lawyer Richard Sobol as they fight against a legal system that is marred with racism.

programme.title: The Girl on the Train
programme.desc: A recent divorcee becomes entangled in a mystery involving her former husband and his new family.

programme.title: The Lookout
programme.desc: Writer-director Scott Frank, who scripted the screen adaptations of Elmore Leonard's "Get Shorty" and "Out of Sight," scores a winner with this gripping noirish caper saga. Joseph Gordon-Levitt stars as a bank janitor who falls in with thieves who are planning to rob his workplace. When he has second thoughts about participating, they ratchet up the pressure with threats to some innocent outsiders. Jeff Daniels, Matthew Goode, Isla Fisher, Carla Gugino, Bruce McGill, Sergio Di Zio.

programme.title: Vindicta
programme.desc: In order to save their city, a group of unlikely heroes band together to thwart a twisted serial killer who has been wreaking havoc in their city. Leading the investigation is a seasoned detective with an unlikely partner in the form of a new paramedic. As they trace and track the killer, they soon realize that they need to tap into their own pasts, where the key to stopping future killings lies.

programme.title: Wolves of War
programme.desc: Decorated British officer Jack Wallace must lead a band of Allied commandos across enemy lines to rescue Professor Hopper, an American scientist held hostage by the Nazis. With information that could turn the tide of war, these unlikely heroes must traverse enemy territory with an untrained US civilian, avoiding brutal Nazi mercenaries and non-stop bombing ? with the fate of the war resting on their shoulders, the outcome of this mission will change the world forever; failure is not an option.

programme.title: The Girl on the Train
programme.desc: A recent divorcee becomes entangled in a mystery involving her former husband and his new family.

programme.title: The Fifth Estate
programme.desc: The true story of WikiLeaks founder Julian Assange and his epic struggle against the US government over classified intelligence documents that were exposed for public scrutiny.

programme.title: Irena's Vow
programme.desc: This period film is set during the German occupation of Poland in the 1940s. Based on true accounts, the drama follows Irene Gut Opdyke, a nineteen-year-old hotel kitchen worker hired by Rugmer, a Nazi official. She was later promoted as a housekeeper to serve in Rugmer's home, where, unbeknownst to him, she also managed to shelter twelve Jews in the cellar.

programme.title: Treasure
programme.desc: An American journalist decides to travel back to Poland with her Holocaust-surviving father. The goal of their trip was to revisit some of his favorite childhood locations. But an internal resistance to his past trauma proved to be more difficult than originally thought.

programme.title: Jeanne du Barry
programme.desc: In eighteenth century France, ambitious commoner Jeanne Vaubernier captivates the Count du Barry, leveraging her charms for social ascent. When introduced to King Louis XV by the Duke of Richelieu, sparks fly, igniting a passionate affair that revitalizes the monarch and leads to Jeanne becoming his beloved favorite.

programme.title: Dream Horse
programme.desc: This comedy film is about Jan Vokes, a Welsh bartender who comes up with the idea of breeding a horse intended for racing. Since she lives in a town that is down on its luck, her neighbors start pitching in and participate in financing for the horse. They see the horse as their chance of redeeming their town and lifting their spirits as it races up the ranks, hopefully to become a champion thoroughbred. Based on a true story.

programme.title: JFK Revisited: Through the Looking Glass
programme.desc: Oliver Stone reassesses John F. Kennedy's assassination 30 years after his first examination of the horrific event that shaped a generation.

programme.title: Hell or High Water
programme.desc: Two desperate brothers commit a string of bank robberies in order to raise the money needed to protect their family farm from foreclosure. Meanwhile, an aging sheriff tracks the heists in an attempt to hunt down those responsible.

actor.role: Vernon PD Officer(as Howard S. Ferguson Jr.)

programme.title: The Last Manhunt
programme.desc: In 1909, Willie Boy and his love Carlota go on the run after he accidentally shoots her father in a confrontation gone terribly wrong. With President Taft coming to the area, the local sheriff leads two Native American trackers seeking justice for their "murdered" tribal leader.

programme.title: Deadlock
programme.desc: Following his son's death at the hands of the police, criminal Ron Whitlock embarks on a quest for revenge. Assembling a team of mercenaries in a plot to overthrow the government, Whitlock seizes power at a government-owned nuclear power plant, ultimately threatening the destruction of a nearby town until a retired Army ranger vows to face Whitlock head-on.

programme.title: What Remains
programme.desc: A tale of forgiveness and testing the limits of forgiveness. After Troy killed his wife, Marshall, the pastor of Hope International Baptist Church in Texas, refused to testify, instead choosing forgiveness. Troy is released five years later, and Marshall gives him menial work when he cannot find any because of his conviction. But when another murder takes place, Troy becomes the center of the investigation, and Marshall's ability to forgive becomes tested to its limits.

programme.title: Black Noise
programme.desc: The narrative follows an expert security team on a deadly rescue mission. The team visits a secluded island to save a high-profile figure from danger. They soon encounter obstacles, including aggressive attack forces and deafening sirens that make their mission next to impossible.

programme.title: First Shift
programme.desc: A rookie cop faces unexpected challenges and dangers during her first night on the job. She must navigate a series of intense situations to prove herself.

programme.title: Hell or High Water
programme.desc: Two desperate brothers commit a string of bank robberies in order to raise the money needed to protect their family farm from foreclosure. Meanwhile, an aging sheriff tracks the heists in an attempt to hunt down those responsible.

programme.title: The Last Manhunt
programme.desc: In 1909, Willie Boy and his love Carlota go on the run after he accidentally shoots her father in a confrontation gone terribly wrong. With President Taft coming to the area, the local sheriff leads two Native American trackers seeking justice for their "murdered" tribal leader.

programme.title: The Score
programme.desc: The story of two criminals with different ambitions, set to music. Two small-time criminals, Mike and Troy, are looking for that one big score and think they've found it. Meeting at a secluded cafe for the handover, they wait as danger moves ever closer. While waiting, Troy falls for the waitress, Gloria, and begins to question his life choices. But it may be too late for him to change his future before it comes to an abrupt end.

programme.title: Welcome to New York
programme.desc: A French diplomat lives the high life during time spent in New York City, but his shenanigans and treatment of women eventually catch up to him.

programme.title: Earth Mama
programme.desc: At twenty-four, a pregnant single mother named Gia struggles to keep her family together as she fights the system to reclaim her two kids, Trey and Shaynah, who are stuck in foster care. Resorting to asking her Bay Area community of friends and social workers for help, Gia tries to navigate several obstacles to secure a better life for her unborn child.

programme.title: Certain Women
programme.desc: A lawyer deals with a hostage crisis in this ensemble drama about women living in Montana. Elsewhere, a wife and mother tries to build a cottage home, and a female farm worker falls for a young woman who teaches adult-education classes.

programme.title: Southside With You
programme.desc: Touching docudrama about Barack Obama's first date with Michelle Robinson, his future wife, during the summer of 1989 in Chicago.

programme.title: The Soloist
programme.desc: Jamie Foxx stars as Nathaniel Ayers, a former violin prodigy whose bouts with schizophrenia landed him on the streets after two years of schooling at Juilliard. Steve Lopez is a disenchanted journalist dealing with a recent divorce. Steve is wandering through Los Angeles' Skid Row when he spots Ayers. The more Steve learns about Ayers, the more he longs to help the troubled soul.

programme.title: The Running Man
programme.desc: A cop in 2019 America is framed for massacring rioting civilians during a famine. After escaping from jail he tries to prove his innocence, but is captured along with an innocent civilian, and they are forced to participate in a violent game show called "The Running Man".

programme.title: Sleepy Hollow
programme.desc: Washington Irving's enduring legend gets a decidedly Gothic makeover in Tim Burton's hauntingly imaginative adaptation. Johnny Depp plays 1799 NYC policeman Ichabod Crane, who's "banished" to upstate Sleepy Hollow to investigate gruesome decapitations. And the locals are convinced that a tortured soul called the Headless Horseman is the culprit. Christina Ricci, Casper Van Dien.

programme.title: Point Break
programme.desc: A sharpshooting FBI agent goes undercover as a surfer to stop a crime wave.

programme.title: Marathon Man
